neighbours.label: The capitalised plural noun that heads a journal or book title: Trends, Frontiers, Annals, Perspectives, Principles, Directions, Foundations, Advances ('Trends in ...', 'Frontiers of ...'). Singular heads (Journal, Handbook) and the same words as lowercase common nouns fire much less.
fire: Hale, R. (2009). Trends in Plant Science 14, 201-209.
Her paper came out in Frontiers in Neuroscience this spring.
Ortiz, M. (1998). Annals of Applied Probability 8, 44-67.
See the review in Perspectives on Psychological Science, vol. 6.
The course text is Principles of Corporate Finance, tenth edition.
Kim, S. (2015). Current Directions in Risk Research 3, 9-15.
It was reprinted in Advances in Marine Biology, volume 30.
quiet: Hale, R. (2009). Journal of Plant Science 14, 201-209.
Her paper came out in Nature Neuroscience this spring.
Ortiz, M. (1998). Bulletin of Applied Probability 8, 44-67.
See the review in Psychological Science, vol. 6.
The course text is Introduction to Corporate Finance, tenth edition.
Kim, S. (2015). Proceedings of the Risk Society 3, 9-15.
Recent trends in plant science favour gene editing.
They pushed the frontiers of marine biology further north.

notes: Card: 'als' (Annals), ' Perspectives', 'iers' (Frontiers), ' Trends', ' Principles', ' Directions', all in citations. Probe: Frontiers 0.95, Trends 0.66, Directions 0.55, Annals 0.54, Perspectives 0.51, Foundations 0.50, Principles 0.44, Advances 0.39, Elements 0.32; lowercase trends 0.27, frontiers 0.22, Handbook of 0.23, Journal 0.18, Reviews 0.10, Proceedings 0.08.
